verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Zulip has an API reference page at zulip.com/api/ listing endpoints such as "Send a message". Nothing shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec at common paths. A static endpoint listing is an adjacent capability, not the interactive, runnable reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
